title: Thu 01 Oct 2026: UK growth revised up, Treasury yields at 24-year high, FCA sustainability rules, Australian private credit freeze
summary: Wall Street ends September with the 10-year Treasury yield above 5.3 per cent despite cooler US inflation, while UK second-quarter growth is revised up to 0.5 per cent and gilts rally ahead of the 28 October budget. Regulation: the FCA finalises UK sustainability reporting rules for listed issuers (PS26/19) and crypto perimeter guidance (PS26/18), and Ombudsman reforms start today. Funds: Metrics freezes Australian private credit funds after an auditor dispute, plus three COO action points and the week's diary.
